newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's 10-year bono hits key 7 pct resistance.
newsitem.headline: Spain's 10-year bono hits key 7 pct resistance.

text.p: Spanish bonds soared on Friday afternoon, with the 10-year yield hitting key resistance at seven percent.
But the move might well be short-lived, dealers said.
They cautioned that bono strength would depend on other European bonds in order to stay at these levels.
"It really is an important psychological level," said a bonds analyst.
The 10-year 8.8 percent bond rose to 111.92/05, yielding seven percent. The yield spread versus Bunds was 136 basis points, versus a historic low of 125 basis points reached on November 25.
The 10-year December bond future also hit a historic high at 111.86.
